text: In eighteen twenty-two, a Scottish soldier sold London a country that did not exist.
Gregor MacGregor arrived calling himself its prince. Poyais, he said, had rich land, rivers full of fish, and a capital with a theater.
There was even a guidebook, by a Captain Thomas Strangeways. There was no Captain Strangeways.
He printed Poyais money. He sold Poyais land. Then he sold Poyais bonds. Two hundred thousand pounds of them.
Two ships of settlers sailed for Central America. They found no capital. No theater. No town. Just jungle.
Luckily, they had brought plenty of Poyais money. Unluckily, nobody had ever heard of it.
Most of them never came home.
Why did it work? Nobody could check. It's like buying a house from photos. The nicer the pictures, the fewer the questions.
When the news reached London, MacGregor was in France, selling Poyais again.
He was put on trial, and walked free. The best lie is a place nobody can visit.
